title: Network coordinator worker Batch 1 state safety
summary: Hardened Batch 1 network coordinator/worker state safety: external done/release now require worker ownership, source identity is normalized for in-flight and queue evidence, claim delivery can roll back safely, done/release acceptance is durable before workers clear reports, stale reclaim and late terminal evidence are persisted, malformed ok claims are blocked before launch, unresolved worker crash state blocks new claims, and pre-start release failures persist retry reports.
reason: The 2026-06-15 network coordinator/worker review confirmed ownership, source identity, and durability gaps that could duplicate processing, lose terminal evidence, or release claims while launched work might continue.
behavior_before: Authenticated clients could omit worker_id on /api/done release/completion, raw path spelling variants could be claimed as different sources, claim/done/release save or delivery failures could leave false acceptance or stale in-memory state, late done reports after reclaim were discarded, malformed ok claims could reach backend launch with an empty source, active-only worker_state.json did not block new claims, and wire-only release POST failures were not persisted for retry.
behavior_after: External done/release rejects missing worker_id, source coordination uses normalized Windows/UNC identity while preserving display paths, failed claim response delivery rolls back and persists rollback, done/release returns retryable failure unless registry save succeeds, stale reclaim and late terminal reports have durable ledgers, malformed ok claim identity is rejected before record creation, unresolved worker_state.json blocks polling, and unstartable release failures are saved for retry.
